comments.body: Hi, I would like to work on this issue if it is still available. I will look into it and open a PR when ready.

I took a quick look, and this seems related to the new prims.uniform decomposition from #187887.

It looks like the compiled path does not handle sliced, non-contiguous views correctly, which can lead to reading invalid memory and returning garbage values. Eager mode takes a different path and works as expected.

I do not have time to work on a fix right now, so feel free to pick this up and send a PR.
